I am as interested in the storyline of the Tactics game as anyone else. But here are some things that the art has me questioning:

 

1) Why is the Wraith not wearing a mask any more? (Also, she looks super good now that she's older. Much more impressive than as the young socialite.)

2) Who is this new Ra? I'd love to have his story.  (Based on the way he is going after Citizen Dawn on the box front, I am secretly hoping that this new Ra is Citizen Burn, the counterpoint to Vengeance's Citizen Slash, as in, Slash and Burn.)

3) I want to hear more about Visionary's choice of a Rubiks Cube and how it grounds her to this reality.

posts.name: TheSoundOfTrees
posts.cooked:
In a D&D campaign I DMed a few years ago, the main artefact was a multidimensional prison shaped as a Rubik's cube. It had to be manipulated from time to time to prevent the entities imprisoned inside from "solving" it and breaking free.

But in this case, I think the cube is also symbolic of her mind and multiple personalities - she is unstable, a creature from a future that doesn't exist anymore, with a "dark" twin inside her head, maybe more "facets" even. Maybe the cube is a way to symbolize her constant work to keep herself "whole" rather than dissolving as the living paradox she has become ?
